title: Abagenyi Abeewuunyisa mu Kibuga Ekiriko Bbugwe
intro: Ekibinja kyatuuka ku miryango gy’ekibuga abantu baakyo gye baali tebamanyirangako mazima. Baaleeta obubaka, naye abatuuze ne bafuuka obulabe, nga batiisatiisa okukola effujjo. Kyokka, okuva mu kifo kye baali batasuubira, eddoboozi limu lyasituka okulwanirira abantu be baali batamanyi, ne liteekawo embeera ey’okukyuka mu ngeri ey’ekitalo.
clues: Twayingira ekibuga abantu baakyo mwe baali bazitoowereddwa obutakkiriza.
Baatutunuulira n’okubuusabuusa ne bagamba nti, ‘Muli bitonde bya bulijjo byokka nga ffe.’
Omusajja yafubutuka okuva ku nkomerero y’ekibuga ewala ennyo okukakasa amazima gaffe.
Yalangirira abantu be nti, ‘Lwaki sisinza Oyo eyantonda?’
Okwegaana kw’ekibuga kwaggwa n’okubwatuka omulundi gumu, era akasiriikiriro ne kafuga we lumu baali basekeredde.

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
